plugins.name: bigslick
plugins.description: START HERE — the required 32-skill core of Big Slick, the open-source marketing distribution for Claude: positioning, ICP, copy, SEO, ads, CRO, pricing, attribution and reporting, plus the onboarding and context machinery every other Big Slick plugin depends on. The ten optional bigslick-* bundles add 217 more skills on top of this one; install them only when you need a specialty. All MIT or Apache-2.0 and redistributable.

plugins.name: bigslick-seo
plugins.description: Technical and on-page SEO: audits, briefs, architecture, backlinks, and the Ahrefs/Semrush/GSC data pulls.

plugins.name: bigslick-ai-search
plugins.description: Generative-engine optimisation: AI Overviews, citations, answer-engine visibility and AI-traffic reporting.

plugins.name: bigslick-paid
plugins.description: Paid media by platform - Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit - plus ad creative and app-store optimisation.

plugins.name: bigslick-content
plugins.description: Content production: editing, calendars, repurposing, newsletters, video, podcasts, imagery and decks.

plugins.name: bigslick-social
plugins.description: Organic social and community: LinkedIn, Reddit, Bluesky, YouTube, developer and open-source channels.

plugins.name: bigslick-gtm
plugins.description: Outbound and sales alignment: prospecting engines, enablement, battlecards, pipeline and revenue ops.

plugins.name: bigslick-lifecycle
plugins.description: Post-signup revenue: activation, retention, churn, referrals, email/SMS sequences and monetisation.

plugins.name: bigslick-strategy
plugins.description: Positioning and growth frameworks drawn from the canon, plus brand foundations and planning rituals.

plugins.name: bigslick-research
plugins.description: Customer and market research: discovery interviews, personas, voice-of-customer, reviews and PR.

plugins.name: bigslick-ops
plugins.description: Marketing operations: analytics stack, experimentation, CRM and chat integrations, launch runbooks.
